generatedWith: built-in image_gen using approved pixel-v4 style; sharp alpha isolation, fixed anatomical registration and nearest-neighbor packing

alphaIsolation.method: Remove generated transparency matting below alpha 200; keep original RGB and make the retained sprite opaque. Original PNGs are retained unchanged.

feedingSources.method: Manual reference-frame mouth/beak ground-contact point in original source coordinates, transformed by the shared anatomical foot registration and stageScale. The independent compound-feed image ground anchor is 3 scene pixels below the contact point; food is absent from animal pixels.
feedingSources.mouthBoundsMethod: A compact common local region of the low mouth/beak near/below the foot plane across the four drawn feeding poses; raised head areas above the foot plane are not exempt. Bounds are kept strictly in front of the explicit foot supportXRange, with a small lower-lip margin, and inverse-mapped to reference source frame 0 for static review.

frames.anchorMethod: V5 feeding artwork: manually registered stance-center x and foreground supporting toe/hoof sole y from the anatomical planted feet; every idle frame shares one sourceCanvas and stageScale, without per-frame bbox fitting or whole-animal rotation. Mouth/head movement remains drawn in the source.
